Sui social gira un video: la preside ann: A video is going round on social media: the head teacher announces that school is closed tomorrow. The voice is hers, the face too.
Within an hour hundreds of people have shared it.
Cosa controlli prima di condividerlo?: What do you check before sharing it?
Apri le risposte e scopri come va a fini: Open the answers and find out how it ends.
Nothing: you can see it’s her.
Oggi l’intelligenza artificiale può crea: Today artificial intelligence can create very realistic voices and faces: seeing isn’t enough any more.
Se la notizia c’è anche sul sito o sul r: Whether the news is also on the school’s website or online register.
Esatto: la fonte ufficiale vince sul vid: Exactly: the official source beats the most convincing video.
Le visualizzazioni misurano quanto gira: Views measure how far something spreads, not whether it’s true.
Scegli il livello: la verità è la stessa: Pick your level: the truth is the same, only the words change.
Non tutto quello che si vede online è ve: Not everything you see online is true: photos and videos can be made up too.
Se una cosa ti sembra strana o ti spaven: If something seems strange or scares you, ask a grown-up.
Foto, video e voci si possono modificare: Photos, videos and voices can be edited or created from scratch with artificial intelligence.
Le notizie false girano veloci perché fa: Fake news spreads fast because it makes people angry, laugh or scared: the emotion comes first, the checking later.
Prima di condividere: chi lo dice, quand: Before sharing: who is saying it, when, and is there an official source?
Deepfake: volti e voci sintetizzati con: Deepfakes: faces and voices synthesised with generative models. Visual clues (artefacts, lip sync, lighting) are no longer enough on their own.
Verifica: ricerca inversa delle immagini: Verification: reverse image search, the original date and source, provenance via the C2PA standard (Content Credentials) when present, confirmation through an independent channel. Against cloned-voice scams the FTC advises calling the person back on a number you know.
Prendi il telefono: lo facciamo insieme,: Grab your phone: let’s do it together, right now.
<strong>Chi lo dice?</strong> Cerca la f: Who is saying it? Look for the original source, not the screenshot.
